# lifesim-jjso: unity-tests runs the client against stale Sim DLLs: a slot reused after another bead landed fails on code it never touched
bug · P1

## Description
2026-10-20, task-loop run of lifesim-hcp7 in slot s1: just unity-tests reported 441/443 (PoseTests.cs:67, sofa rotation 1 expects 90 gets 270, and rotation 3). The slot's client/Assets/Plugins/Sim/Sim.Core.dll was built 2026-10-19 20:35 (lifesim-rl2t), before lifesim-d5f.38 changed BodySlotSnapshot.Resolve and landed at 22:26. origin/main is green (d5f.38's gate passed). Same class as lifesim-rl2t's stale-DLL failure on 2026-10-19. An icon-only bead burned a write round on it.

## Steps to Reproduce

In a slot whose Sim DLLs predate a landed src/ change: git checkout -B t origin/main; just unity-tests. PoseTests fails although main is green.

## Acceptance Criteria

just unity-tests (and unity-check) republish the Sim DLLs when src/ is newer than them (tools/client_setup.sh sim), or fail at once with that instruction; the repro above passes.

## Touches

justfile (unity-tests, unity-check), tools/client_setup.sh
